Hero_Desc_Silvia:
Silvia, the Silver Dragon who hatched from an egg cared for by Vivi.
Perhaps influenced by Vivi, she speaks in a distinctive manner and aspires to become an elegant lady.
Her immense pride can make her appear arrogant, but she is also exemplary in her sincere devotion to the Dragons and tireless effort.
Album_Wish_Silvia: To become a truly elegant lady
Album_Silvia1: The relationship between Silvia and Vivi is unique. It is rare to see a mother and daughter in Elias. Vivi cared for Silvia from the time she was still an egg, so might they not be considered a true mother and daughter?
Album_Silvia2: Silvia is a Dragon of immense pride. She takes great pride in being a Silver Dragon and aims to follow her mother Vivi's example by excelling in the ranking battles, then someday rise to second place among all Dragons.
Album_Silvia3: Silvia believes herself to be an elegant lady. Her speech and behavior are proud, haughty, and occasionally melodramatic, but she bears no malice. Let us try to understand her attitude with a broad and generous heart.
Album_Silvia4: Silvia calls herself the Grand Duchess of True Silver. She calls Goldy the Grand Duke of Gold and claims she was originally a Dragon meant to stand as his equal. I do not fully understand, but I shall accept it.
Album_Silvia5: Perhaps influenced by Vivi's manner of speech, Silvia speaks in a distinctive style of her own. She calls it the speech of a lady and stubbornly maintains it even when her listeners describe it as strange.
Album_Silvia6: Silvia holds a romanticized image of ladies. She claims that a tea party is the ultimate amusement enjoyed by a lady, but how can sitting, drinking tea, and chatting possibly be the ultimate amusement?
Album_Silvia7: Silvia is the first baby Dragon born into Dragon society in a very long time. Perhaps that is why most Dragons adore her. At Opal's request, Silvia calls her 'senior' and follows her around, and even Silphir looks after Silvia in various ways.
LoveHero_Silvia: With this maiden's radiance, I shall illuminate the path before you, Master!
LoveHeroCancel_Silvia: Th-This maiden shall await the day when you summon her once more...
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Hate1: She attempted to slice the meat elegantly with a knife, only to scatter sauce everywhere. She had no choice but to eat it with her hands, then blushed because she had behaved unlike a lady.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Hate2: She puffed out her cheeks in disappointment, calling it thoughtless and inconsiderate toward a lady to serve her a can without even opening it.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like1: She was delighted, saying that a fine cup of tea greatly assists in cultivating the mind. At Silvia's invitation, we sat together and enjoyed a leisurely tea party.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like10: She was pleased, saying its elegant radiance made it a fitting food for her. She gradually poured warm water into a teacup and sipped while savoring the light and fragrance that blossomed as the powder dissolved.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like2: She spared no praise, calling it a lavish banquet worthy of the Grand Duchess of True Silver.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like3: She was satisfied, calling it a supremely elegant dish dressed in a pure white gown.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like4: Her bewilderment at being served a piece of wood lasted only until I sliced it and revealed the cross section. Then she rejoiced at what she called a truly remarkable cake.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like5: After pouring the powder into her mouth, she grimaced in surprise at its tartness. Yet she struggled to compose her expression, saying it would be impolite to me after I had prepared the food.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like6: She marveled that although it appeared simple, everything from its delicate color to its finely crafted shape revealed tremendous care.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like7: She liked the splendid packaging and called it a refined dessert that could be eaten in a single bite. The ribbon tied around the box must have pleased her, because she quietly took it with her.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like8: When I taught her to dissolve it in water, one sip brought an expression to her face as though she had discovered an entirely new world. She was delighted that it could also be served as cool iced tea on a hot day.
Food_ChefNote_Silvia_Like9: First, the jewel-like appearance of the candies captivated her. Then the meanings contained in their shapes captivated her again. She seemed moved, calling them 'noble candies symbolizing harmony among all races.'

LoveLetter_Silvia:
I trust you have been well, Master. Silvia humbly offers her greetings.
Of all those this maiden observed from beyond her eggshell, were I asked to name the most wondrous, my answer would surely be you. Beyond your dignified bearing, the nobility concealed behind words and actions that may at first seem lighthearted possesses a depth this maiden cannot hope to measure. My dream is to follow your example and stand proudly as the radiant Grand Duchess of True Silver. Until that glorious day arrives, I pray that you will guide this maiden along the proper path.
LoveCall_Silvia:
Greetings, Master.
You have been especially present in my thoughts today, so this maiden has contacted you.
Were I to follow my heart, I would visit without warning merely to offer my greetings. Yet I feared such an arrival might be discourteous, and thus contacted you in this fashion instead. Did you say that I may visit freely at any time? I understand. Then henceforth, I shall call upon you without reservation.

That you would even inquire after this maiden leaves me at a loss. I have been faring better than ever, and Mother remains in excellent health. Lately... Ahem! You have often entered my thoughts, Master, likely because of my deep respect for you. Though this maiden is a proud and noble lady, each time I see you, I recognize how much I still lack. I shall continue observing and learning from you, striving to become an even finer and more ele~gant lady.
